C1367.title: 2026 Cross-Chain Bridge Attack Landscape
C1367.summary: According to PeckShield monitoring, as of mid-May 2026, the crypto sector has witnessed 8 major cross-chain bridge-related attacks, with hackers stealing approximately $328.6 million from cross-chain protocols, indicating persistently high frequency and massive losses from cross-chain bridge attacks.

references.title: 8 Major Cross-Chain Bridge Attacks in 2026, Cumulative Losses Reach $328.6 Million | PANews
